info.title: Rixus Real Estate API
info.description: Backend REST API for Rixus Real Estate Project

get.description: Returns the operational status of the service

Browser entry point for Google OAuth. If unauthenticated, Cloudflare Access intercepts and prompts for Google OAuth credentials. Upon successful authentication, issues a refresh token and redirects back to the frontend.

302.description: Redirects to frontend application after Google OAuth verification

post.description: Registers a new user account with name and email. Authenticated via Cloudflare Access Google OAuth; new users are assigned the VIEWER role.

201.description: User created successfully, returns JWT token

400.description: Invalid email or name is required

401.description: Cloudflare Access Google OAuth authentication required to register

403.description: Registration email must match authenticated Google account

post.description: Authenticates user via Cloudflare Access Google OAuth (Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header) and returns JWT tokens

parameters.name: Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion
parameters.description: Signed Cloudflare Access JWT assertion verifying Google OAuth identity

401.description: Cloudflare Access Google OAuth authentication required or token invalid

404.description: User not registered in database

post.description: Reads the refresh_token HttpOnly cookie and returns a fresh short-lived access token

200.description: Token refreshed successfully, returns new access_token

401.description: Missing or invalid refresh token cookie

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's ID, name, email, and role

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid Bearer token

404.description: User not found

get.summary: Aggregated summary of portfolio metrics for dashboard KPI cards
get.description: Returns total asset value, monthly revenue, total units, occupied units, and occupancy rate for the caller's properties.
Returns open maintenance issues and capital projects across portfolio properties

post.description: Logs an issue (e.g. concrete crack, remodel shower, build garage, replace windows) for a property

get.description: Returns active contractors, specialties, service areas, and past jobs worked on

post.description: Registers a new contractor with trade specialty and operating service area

get.description: Returns stored documents, leases, photos, and standard templates

200.description: List of documents and media items

post.description: Uploads PDF, image, video, audio, or general document tied to a property or unassigned

get.description: Returns all properties belonging to the authenticated user

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid Bearer token

post.description: Creates a new property for the authenticated user

400.description: Invalid input - address is required and monthlyRent must be non-negative

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid Bearer token

get.description: Returns property details by ID if owned by caller or caller is ADMIN

404.description: Not found

put.description: Replaces the property's address, unit count and financial fields; omitted financial fields reset to their defaults. units cannot drop below the highest unit a tenant occupies, and legal_entity_id must belong to the property owner. Requires owning the property or ADMIN role.

404.description: Property not found, or record not found on this property

delete.description: Permanently deletes the property together with its tenants, units, loans, underwriting models and ledger transactions. Legal entities are kept. Requires owning the property or ADMIN role.

204.description: Property and all related data deleted

404.description: Property not found, or record not found on this property

get.description: Returns all properties belonging to the specified user ID (requires ownership or ADMIN role)
Returns all tenants of the property, ordered by unit number. Requires owning the property or ADMIN role.

404.description: Property not found

post.description: Adds a tenant to the property. unit_number defaults to 1 and must not exceed the property's units; pet_count defaults to 0. Requires owning the property or ADMIN role.

404.description: Property not found

get.summary: List all tenants of a property
get.description: Returns all tenants of the property, ordered by unit number (same result as GET /api/properties/{id}/tenants). Requires owning the property or ADMIN role.

404.description: Property not found

get.description: Returns a tenant of the property. Requires owning the property or ADMIN role.

404.description: Property not found, or tenant not found on this property

put.description: Replaces the tenant's fields. Omitted unit_number/pet_count reset to their defaults and omitted dates are cleared. The tenant stays on its property. Requires owning the property or ADMIN role.

404.description: Property not found, or tenant not found on this property

delete.description: Deletes a tenant of the property. Requires owning the property or ADMIN role.

404.description: Property not found, or tenant not found on this property

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid Bearer token

post.description: Promotes an existing user to ADMIN. Requires an active ADMIN bearer token.

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid Bearer token

get.description: Returns per-property pro forma metrics and a weighted summary (dollar totals summed before ratios are computed) for the caller's active properties. Filters combine with AND.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Target user (another user requires ADMIN role)

parameters.name: legal_entity_id
parameters.description: Only properties held by this legal entity

parameters.name: property_id
parameters.description: Comma-separated property ids; a single id scopes the summary to that property

200.description: Summary, per-property metrics and the user's legal entities

BearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token obtained from /api/auth/login or /api/auth/register

FinancialMetrics.description: Annual pro forma metrics for one property or a weighted rollup of many. Currency fields are annual dollars except monthly_cash_flow; *_pct fields are percentages (7.25 = 7.25%). Ratios are null when their denominator is zero.

scope_id.description: PORTFOLIO, CATEGORY, a legal entity id, or a property id

land_value_allocation_pct.description: Fraction of the purchase price allocated to land (not depreciated)

utility_config.description: Who pays each utility. Missing keys default to water/trash LANDLORD, electric/gas TENANT.

is_active.description: Inactive properties are left out of the financial analysis

CreatePropertyRequest.description: Create or replace a property. Omitted financial fields take their defaults (on PUT, they reset to them).

monthly_payment.description: Scheduled payment used by the analysis (P&I, or interest only during an IO period) plus PMI

id.description: Null when no model is saved and the defaults apply

unit_id.description: Must be a unit of the same property

amount.description: Positive amount; the category gives the direction
